messages:
incidents-bot: PAGED: Canary health alert for release "textgen:v4.0.0-rc2". Error-rate jump ~15%, garbled completions. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/c/inc/rc2-xyz

deploy-bot: Canary group: canary-west-1 (5% traffic). Started rollout 3723459987.

emma-oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Can someone grab canary logs and artifact metadata?

sam: Logs show tokenizer errors and weird null bytes in outputs. sample: ```ERROR tokenizer: invalid token id -1 at pos 0
OUT: "\u0000\ufffd\u0000"``` Hard fail for many prompts.

lia: Checking artifact signing: promoted bundle metadata shows mismatched hash. promoted: sha256=deadbeefcafebabe, expected from build: sha256=feedface12345678. Packaging pipeline promoted wrong artifact tag.

sre-bot: Traffic routing snapshot: canary-west-1 -> textgen:v4.0.0-rc2 5%. Others on v3.9.7.

emma-oncall: Flip rollout flag and drain traffic. `/ff set canary/textgen-v4 false` — executing.

deploy-bot: Feature flag canary/textgen-v4 set to false by emma-oncall. Drain started.

support-liz: Noted 12 new tickets in last 15m, customers reporting "gibberish completions" and shortened outputs. Escalating to SEs.

se-maria: Pulling sample ids from support. TKT-6012, TKT-6015 look like corrupted outputs consistent with tokenizer errors.

emma-oncall: Initiating safe alias rollback to last stable weightset v3.9.7: `weights alias promote textgen:stable@v3.9.7 --region=global` starting job jb-3729001.

lia: Stopping further promotions in packaging pipeline and starting a verification job to detect mismatches. Also creating block to prevent auto-promote until RCA.

sre-bot: Post-action snapshot: 100% traffic -> textgen:v3.9.7. Error rates returning to baseline after ~40s.

sam: Confirming: tokenization errors cleared on canary hosts. Logs now normal.

emma-oncall: Mitigation verified. Marking incident mitigated. Handoff: lia (packaging), sam (runtime/tokenizer), carol (customer comms), emma-oncall remains on follow-up.

pm-ana: Please create a short timeline and estimate customer impact. Also prepare customer-facing note draft.

carol: INC-3723 created. Collected logs, job ids (jb-3729001), support tickets, and tagging oncall. Will coordinate comms with support-liz.

emma-oncall: Closing pager. Follow-up owners to prioritize automated artifact-signature validation and gating promotions. Thanks everyone.

incidents-bot: Pager closed by emma-oncall at 3723460200."
